title: Deltarune - Hip Shop
description:
This is the Card Castle shop theme from Deltarune, which is where the sexy mofo named Rouxls Kaard sells his stuff when he's not making puzzles... and mac-n-cheese of course.

This would be especially fitting for shops, of course, but it could also be a great fit for space and abstract overworlds due to it's Ａ　Ｅ　Ｓ　Ｔ　Ｈ　Ｅ　Ｔ　Ｉ　Ｃ　　Ｆ　Ｅ　Ｅ　Ｌ. Maybe even night levels and cutscenes too!
